spans.s:
chuṭ (LP), cf. choṭanīya; Gujarātī chod̤āvavuṃ; also cf. granthi-baddhair=api drammaiḥ kṣetraṃ choṭayituṃ dhāraṇiko na labhate, ‘[when the date is already over], the debtor will not get his farm liberated by the ready money tied in a piece of cloth’.
 Cf. patra-grahāt chuṭanti (LP), ‘will be free from the bond’; also Gujarātī chaṭśe.
